descriptionHtml: In a successful gathering of 40+ eager participants, 'CognifAI: Navigating the World of AI for Beginners' illuminated the virtual world on September 24, 2023, at 6:00 PM via Zoom. The event, hosted by the IEEE Women in Engineering Student Branch Affinity Group at the University of Peradeniya, featured Mr. Amalka Withana, an Architect specializing in Analytics & AI at Axiata Digital Labs, as the distinguished resource person. Mr. Withana not only provided foundational insights into AI and ML but also ignited motivation among attendees, guiding them on their journey into these transformative fields. The interactive session left participants equipped with knowledge, resources, and renewed enthusiasm, ensuring a bright future for their AI and ML endeavors.
